postal_system.postal_code: nullable; exact values and syntax not validated
postal_system.scope: UPU September 2025 says Yemen does not require postcodes. Yemen Post separately says a P.O. box subscriber receives a box number and a postal code tied to the post office by area. No code list, syntax, assignment table, map relation or polygon was published in the reviewed pages.

identifier_namespaces.rule: Preserve an exact Yemen Post code and its documented office or P.O. box semantics only when a current source row is pinned. A P.O. box number is separate and neither value implies a delivery-area polygon.
An explicit operator office point or delivery relation retains its own source and validity and is not expanded into an area by proximity.
Source-qualified governorate, district and locality context retains exact edition and geometry authority and never becomes official postal geometry by containment.
House, street, premise and building display requires explicit permitted source records and a stable address-to-building relation.
Independent spatial index from reviewed geometry; never represented as a Yemen Post code or official postal area.

stages.definition: Address-format inventory and synthetic Postal Forge planning pack only.
Reviewed UPU/Yemen Post policy, optional office-code, rights, privacy and authority contract with exact reference receipts.

A current rights-cleared complete-for-declared-scope Yemen Post code, office/delivery-context, civic-address or administrative/locality dataset with stable source-row identity, Arabic source fields, retrieval time, edition, validity, schema and SHA-256 reproducibly produces approved immutable digest-pinned artifacts and passes the actual YE AGID loader/API/app. UPU no-required-postcode classification keeps postalCode nullable; any operator code attached to a P.O. box or office retains that exact non-area semantics unless an independent current authority publishes explicit postal-area geometry. A valid area must be Polygon/MultiPolygon with source authority, official/derived/virtual class, basis date and confidence and must pass normalized search, all result/failure states, fit, translucent fill, clear outline and clear/re-search. Administrative boundaries, office points, P.O. boxes, routes, buffers, Voronoi cells, AGID cells and learned/generated regions cannot become official postal polygons. House numbers and buildings require explicit permitted stable relations. Synthetic tests, policy pages, a placeholder office-map link or metadata alone never establish M2.

agid_integration.current_scope: YE address metadata and synthetic Postal Forge planning pack only; generic Postal Context data runtime remains disabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A licensed descriptor, approved immutable real-data artifacts and actual YE loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture an official postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, civic or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified; derived and virtual regions require explicit separate provenance.
